thread:
carla: Quick alert: PR #489 (migration guide updates + SDK snippets) shows green GH checks but Netlify preview is 404ing for the migration page. Planning to hold merge until we confirm previews render. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489

 tom: I can repro the 404 on Netlify preview. Vercel preview loads fine (https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/preview/7890). Looks like Netlify's rewrite rules didn't catch the new /migration path.

 rachel: Local preview works for me (pnpm docs:dev -> http://localhost:3000) and the migration page is present. Steps I use: `pnpm install` then `pnpm docs:dev` (or `yarn && yarn docs:serve`). If anyone needs to test locally I can share a short docker command too.

 tom: Thanks. Can someone with deploy permissions trigger a Netlify redeploy? I suspect the redirect/rewrites blob in _redirects was not copied in the last build.

 vercel-bot: Preview deployment ready: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/preview/7890  status: success

 carla: @tom I retriggered Netlify via the site UI (Redeploy from branch). Also added a comment in PR to check _redirects.

 ci-bot: GitHub Actions: workflow 'docs-preview' re-run requested by carla. Current status: queued.

 tom: After redeploy Netlify now returns 200 for /migration but static example snippet didn't hydrate (console shows "Failed to fetch /static/examples/migration-sample.json"). That path exists in the repo under `docs/static/examples` though.

 rachel: If it's a path mismatch we might need to reference `/docs/static/examples/...` depending on build base path. Locally the basePath option is configured when running docs:dev. Try adding a sanity check to the build step to list `dist/static` contents.

 carla: I'll push a tiny change to the build script to echo the static directory contents during CI. Adding `ls -R public || true` to the Netlify build command so we can see what's packaged. Won't change content.

 ci-bot: docs-preview workflow started  job: build-preview. Logs: running build...

 tom: New Netlify deploy completed and the example loads. Looks like the previous build's cache skipped a copy step. We should add a smoke test in GH Actions to curl the migration page and ensure 200.

 rachel: Agree on smoke test. For now I approve the PR in the thread; will leave a review on GitHub once CI artifacts show the new build logs.

 carla: Thanks. Plan: wait for CI smoke (curl check) then merge during the 18:00-19:00 PDT window. If the smoke fails we revert the build-cache change.

 ci-bot: docs-preview workflow completed: build: passed, deploy-preview: succeeded, smoke-curl: passed

 tom: All green. Merging in 10m. Reminder for docs team: add a developer note in CONTRIBUTING about how to run `pnpm docs:dev` and check `public` for static assets to avoid this.

 carla: Merged at 1775559530. Will open follow-up issue for the smoke test and the contributor docs note.

 rachel: Nice, thanks all. I'll monitor the docs-alert channel for any post-merge regressions.
